about_the_game:
Can you hear me?

Perhaps "hear" isn't the right word.

Are my words reaching you, then?

...

Unfortunately, I don't know whether you responded or not.

I think my CommGear is malfunctioning.

For now, I'll hope that this is getting through, and tell you what you need to know.

This is a collaborative experiment between you and me.

It's all right if you're uneasy, not knowing what kind of experiment it is.

I'll try to summarize the key points to better prepare you for what's coming.

Game Features

  • Each interchange between the two of us will last approximately three minutes

  • My words will reach you fully voiced

  • The results of the experiment will change based on the content and direction of our conversations

  • Most actions will be performed by selecting one of several available options from the interface

  • At times, I may require you to prove that you exist outside of my own dimension

  • When that happens, you should select an option from beyond the normal interface

  • Even if I die, I want you to continue the experiment

Does that last point bother you?

The fact is, I don't have enough time to complete this experiment. I need your help to finish it.

Because, you are

I'm out of time

If you wish to join the experiment

I'll be waiting, right here.

English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
